content:
Marie K: Quick sync — SEO checklist for next week's launch. Need a lean plan: keywords + SERP intent, schema (event/blog/article), internal linking + pillar pages, redirects for legacy docs, and webinar landing page routing to HubSpot. Who can own each piece? :rocket:

Owen L: I can own keyword research and mapping. Plan: top 10 keywords per page, prioritize by intent (commercial/educational), add SERP feature targets (people also ask). Will share a sheet by EOD.

Jess P: I'll do schema + structured data. For the webinar page we need Event schema + speaker and FAQ markup. Proposed JSON-LD stub: ```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference Launch Webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-04-01T16:00:00Z",
  "location": { "@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinar" }
}
``` Will add offers/ticket data later.

Sam R: Redirect audit and canonical checks — I'll run a crawl tonight and output a 301 map. Need list of high-traffic legacy URLs from Analytics + top referrers. Also will add a few rewrite rules for nginx: ```rewrite ^/old-path/(.*)$ /new-path/$1 permanent;```

Nora M: I'll wire the webinar form to HubSpot + do lead routing. Confirming we want utm_source=launch_email and route MQLs to AE queue 'launch-2026' via webhook. I'll test in staging.

seo-bot: crawl finished (quick): 3 priority 404s on /docs/deprecated-guide, 7 meta robots noindex found, mobile CLS high on webinar-template. Full report uploaded: https://redwood.ai/reports/seo-scan-1768123456

Marie K: Great. Timeline: keywords by Tue, schema + JSON-LD by Wed, redirects map by Wed, routing tested by Thu. Can we do a 15-min check on Thu morning? @Owen L @Jess P @Sam R @Nora M

Owen L: noted. I'll include recommended H1/H2 variants and suggested internal links (pillar -> webinar -> docs).

Jess P: I'll post schema snippets to the content repo PR and add a unit test for JSON-LD rendering.

Sam R: sharing the initial redirect map in the channel now. Quick Q: do we preserve query strings on some keys? @Nora M what do we do with utm params?

Nora M: Keep utm parameters; HubSpot needs them. Sam, set redirects to preserve query string: append `$is_args$args` in nginx rewrite.

Marie K: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers ping #eng-oncall for routing or #eng-platform for CDN cache purge. Thanks team :tada:
